description: Changelog: Small optimizations for smoother, more sensible controls; removed deleted widget groups from the repair screen; improved visibility of some touch controls in and out of game; optimized inventory buttons; fixed the bug where Menu 1 could not be triggered

buttonList.text: This touch layout was made by one person; check the "Feedback" screen with questions

Changelog: watermark hidden by default, fixed some version bugs, removed six-finger mode
Optimized C magnifier module, fixed screen and classic mode auto-gear, added immersive mode expand
Fine-tuned immersive mode opacity, changed some screen touch logic, fixed known bugs,
descriptions of touch on the selection screen changed, boat key open method moved to selection screen, second
boat key removed, Bedrock-style boat key channel removed, Assist and Touch Features major update,
added C-key zoom, quick chat, mouse move

Out of space, so only this much is shown; the rest, adventurers, explore on your own!
